quick_facts.label: What the job is
quick_facts.value: Health and safety engineers promote worksite or product safety by applying knowledge of industrial processes, mechanics and chemistry; the occupation includes industrial product safety engineers.

quick_facts.label: Other names for it
quick_facts.value: Job titles O*NET reports for this occupation (Health and Safety Engineers, Except Mining Safety Engineers and Inspectors) include Safety Engineer, Product Safety Engineer, Industrial Safety Engineer and Health and Safety Specialist.

quick_facts.label: Engineering degree in India
quick_facts.value: In India, the UGC specification of degrees lists B.Tech and B.E. as four-year bachelor's degrees entered after 10+2.

sections.heading: What a health and safety engineer does
paragraphs: Health and safety engineers promote worksite or product safety by applying knowledge of industrial processes, mechanics and chemistry; the occupation includes industrial product safety engineers.

The tasks below are taken from the O*NET profile for Health and Safety Engineers, Except Mining Safety Engineers and Inspectors. O*NET is the US Department of Labor's occupation database, so this describes the job as it is profiled in the United States; titles and duties in Indian companies can differ.
bullets: Investigate industrial accidents, injuries or occupational diseases to find causes and preventive measures.
Run or coordinate worker training on safety laws, regulations and hazard monitoring.
Recommend procedures to detect, prevent and remove physical, chemical or other product hazards.

sections.heading: How people get into this job
